verses.en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.sm: Iese. O le faauuina o Tavita, ma lona aea o Ierusalema. O ona tagata totoa Isaraelu uma ia Tavita i Heperona, ua faapea mai, Faauta, o i matou nei o ou ivi ma ou aano.

verses.en: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.sm: O anamua foi, ina o fal Saulo ma tupu, o oe lava na e feta‘ita‘iina‘i ia Isaraelu. Na fetalai mai foi le ALII lou Atua ia te oe, O oe e te leoleo i loʻu nuu o Isaraelu, e fai foi oe ma ta‘ita‘i i loʻu nuu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
verses.sm: Ona o mai lea o toeaina uma o Isaraelu i le tupu i Heperona, ia latou osia le feagaiga ma Tavita i luma o le ALII i Heperona; ua latou faauuina foi Tavita e fai ma tupu ia Isaraelu, e tusa ma le afioga a le Atn ia Samuelu.

verses.en: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o Tavita ma Isaraelu uma i Ierusalema, o Iepuse lea; sa i ai sa lepusé o E o mau i le nuu.

verses.en: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai e na mau i lepuse ia Tavita, E te le sao mai iinei. A ua aea e Tavita le ‘olo o Siona, o le aai foi lea a Tavita.

verses.en: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu ai lea o Tavita, O sé na te muai fasia sa lepusé, e fai o ia ma aln sili ma ta‘ita‘i. Na muamua ona alu ae o loapo le tama a Seruia, ona fai lea o ja ma alii sili.

verses.en: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.sm: Ua mau Tavita i le ‘olo; o le mea lea na faaigoaina ai e i latou, o le aai o Tavita.

verses.en: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.sm: Ua ati e ia le aai e faataaliolio, e amata mai i Milo e soo ai. Ua faaolaina e Ioapo o e na totoe i le aai.

verses.en: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.
verses.sm: Ua tupu pea lava le mamalu o Tavita; sa ia te ia foi le AL11 o “au.

verses.en: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
verses.sm: O alii sili nei o toa sa ia Tavita, o e na faamalolosi faatasi ma ia i lona malo, atoa ma Isaraelu uma e fai o ia ma tupu, e tusa ma le afioga a le Au ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
verses.sm: O le faitau lenei o toa sa ia Tavita; o Iasapama o le atalii o Hakamoni, o le alii sili ia o e avea ‘au; o ia lava na sii lona tao i tagata e toatolu selau na fasia e ia i le aso E tasi.

verses.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
verses.sm: E aupito ane ia te ia o Eleasaro o le atalii o Toto, o lo sa Aoki, o ia o so le au toa e toatolu.

verses.en: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.sm: O ia sa ia Tavita i Fesetame, sa faapotopoto ai Filisitia e tau ai le taua; sa i ai le fasi fanua ua lilo i karite; na sosola le nuu i luma o Filisitia.

verses.en: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.sm: Ua faamau foi i latou i totonu o le fanua, ua faasaoina ai, ua fasia foi Filisitia; ua faja foi e le ALr le faaolataga tele.

verses.en: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.sm: Nao ifo le toatolu nai le toatolugafulu o e ua sili, ua co ia Tavita i le papa i le ana o Atulama, ua to lauapi foi o ‘au a Filisitia i le vanu o sa Rafa.

verses.en: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Beth-lehem.
verses.sm: Sa i ai Tavita i le ‘olo i ia ona po; o le leoleoga foi o Filisitia sa i Peteleema i ia ona po.

verses.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!
verses.sm: Ua manao Tavita, ua faapea ane, Ta fia inu vai ai le vaieli o Peteleema o i ai i le faitotoa!

verses.en: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
verses.sm: Ona sofaia lea o “au a Filisitia e ia tagata e toatolu, ma ua latou utu ai vai i le vaieli o Peteleema ua ile faitotoa, ua au mai ma ua avane ia Tavita; a ua le mafai Tavita ona inu ai, a ua liligi atu i le Atnu.

verses.en: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.sm: Ua faapea o ia, Lo‘u Atua e, ia mamao ia te au ona faia o lenei mea; ou te inu ea le totò o nei tagata e na toai? ana na o toai i latou e au mai ai; ua ia le mafai ona inu ai. O mea ia sa faia e ia toa e toatolu.

verses.en: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.sm: O Apisai le uso o loapo o ia ua sili i le toatolu; o ia foi na sii lona tao i tagata e tolu selau, ua fasi ia i latou, ua ta'ua ai o ia faatasi ma le toatolu.

verses.en: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.sm: O lo le toatolu, ua sili ona viia o ia i le toalua; sa fai o ia mo latou alii; a e lei aulia le toatolu muamua.

verses.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
verses.sm: O Penaia le atalii o Ioiata, le atalii o le tagata fitafita mai Kapeseelu, o le na faia mea tetele; o ia na fasia tagata Moapi e faamataleona e toalua; o ia foi na alu ifo ma fasi le leona i totonu o le lua i ona po o kiona.

verses.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.sm: Na fasiotia foi e ia o le tagata Aikupito, o le tagata tinoese lava, e lima kupita lona maualuga. Sa i ai foi i le lima o le Aikupito o le tao e pei o le laau faalava o lé lalaga ie; na ia alu ifo ia te ia ma le tootoo, ua seia le tao nai le lima o le Aikupito, ma na fasioti ia te ia i lona lava tao.

verses.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.sm: O mea ia na faia e Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata, ua taʻua ai o ia faatasi ma toa e toatolu.

verses.en: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.sm: Faauta, sa sili ona viia o ja i le toatolugafulu, a ua le aulia e ia le toatolu muamua. Ua tofia o ia e Tavita e pule i e na faafeao ia te ia.

verses.en: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
verses.sm: O e ua totoa foi i “au; o Asaelu le uso o Ioapo, o Eleana le atalii o Toto o le Peteleema,

verses.en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.sm: o Sama le Arari, o Helesa le Pelone,

verses.en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
verses.sm: o Ira le atalii o Ikesa le Tikoa, o Apieseru le Anatota,

verses.en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.sm: o Sepekai o lo sa Usa, o Ilai o lo sa Aoki,

verses.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.sm: o Maarai o lo sa Netopá, o Heleta le atalii o Paana olo sa Netopa,

verses.en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.sm: o Itai le atalii o Ripai o le Kipea, o le aai a le fanauga a Peniamina, o Penaia le Piratonu,

verses.en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.sm: o Huri mai vaitafe o Kaasa, o Avielu o le Arepa,

verses.en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.sm: o Asemau le Paarumi, o Eliepa le Saalepo,

verses.en: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.sm: o atalii o Asema le Kisoni, o Ionatana le atalii o Sage le Arari,

verses.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.sm: o Aiamu le atalii o Sakaru le Arari, o Elefala le atalii o Uro,

verses.en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.sm: o Eferu le Mekira, o Akia le Pelone,

verses.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.sm: o Heserai le Karamelu, o Narai le ataw o Esepai,

verses.en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
verses.sm: o Ioelu le uso o Natano, O Mepekara le atalii o Akara,

verses.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.sm: o Seleka o le Amoni, o Naarai le Perota o le soátau o Ioapo le tama a Seruia,

verses.en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.sm: o Ira le sa Ieterò, o Karepa le sa Ieterò,

verses.en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.sm: o Uria o lo sa Heti, o Sapata le atalii o Akelai,

verses.en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.sm: o Atina le atalii o Sesa o lo sa Reupena, o le alii o sa Reupena, sa ja te ia foi o tagata e toatolugafulu,

verses.en: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.sm: o Hanana le atalii o Maaka, ma losafata le Metini,

verses.en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
verses.sm: o Usia le Aserota, o Sama ma leielu o atalii o Hotama le Aroeru,

verses.en: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.sm: o Ietiaelu le atalii o Semeri, ma Ioka lona uso, o le Tise,

verses.en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.sm: o Elielu le Makavi, ma laripa, ma losavia, o atalii o Elenaama, ma Itema o le Moapi,

verses.en: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
verses.sm: O Elielu ma Opeta, ma lasielu le Mesopaia.
